title: Statistical Computing
standfirst: Simulation, resampling, MCMC and the numerical methods behind modern statistical practice.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces computational methods used in statistical estimation and learning problems
faculty: Prof. Dootika Vats, Assistant Professor, Department of Mathematics and Statistics, IIT Kanpur

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Random number generation; Congruential methods; Discrete sampling (inverse transform, accept-reject); Generating Bernoulli, Poisson, binomial, and geometric variables.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Sampling techniques; Composition method; Inverse transform for continuous distributions; Visualization in R.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Advanced sampling methods; Accept-reject optimization; Box-Muller method for Gaussian variables; Proposal selection strategies.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Ratio-of-uniforms method; Multivariate and mixture sampling; Specialized distributions (beta, Dirichlet); Multidimensional sampling.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Monte Carlo methods; Importance sampling; Variance reduction; Optimal proposal distributions; R-based implementations.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Weighted importance sampling; Likelihood functions; Maximum likelihood estimation (MLE); Linear regression via MLE.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Penalized regression; Ridge regression; Likelihood visualization; Taylor series approximations; Simulation in R.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Numerical optimization; Newton-Raphson methods (univariate and multivariate); Logistic regression via MLE; Convergence behavior.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Gradient-based optimization; Gradient ascent; MM (Majorize-Minimize) algorithms; Applications in regression and estimation.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm; Gaussian mixture models; Multivariate clustering; Handling missing/censored data.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Model evaluation and selection; Cross-validation; Bootstrapping; Resampling methods; Choosing hyperparameters and model complexity.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Applications of SGD with code. Simulated annealing: examples, codes, and challenges
